nodes.description: External caller address supplied by the transaction; used for owner checks and allowance accounting.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance and balance updates directly without SafeMath.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view whitelist gate allowing owner, UNI, pair address, tradeAddress, canSale addresses, otherwise deferring to condition.
Internal view sale-limit validator reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-gated function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address and payload.
Owner-gated initializer setting sale limits and sale count from supplied parameters.
Owner-gated batch distribution multiplying value by array length and updating balances.
Owner-gated setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation using keccak256 and init code hash.
Payable constructor minting supply to deployer and granting infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Private owner address controlling privileged functions.
Whitelisted trade address bypassing the condition check in ensure.
Public mapping of address balances mutated without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of allowances mutated directly.
Private mapping of addresses allowed to sell without condition checks.
Private mapping counting sell operations per address.
Private maximum number of sales configured through init.
Private minimum sale amount threshold.
Private maximum sale amount threshold.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Low-level delegatecall executing arbitrary user supplied code in the contract context.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance additions in batchSend.
Subtraction and addition on allowance and balanceOf maps performed without SafeMath.
Local total amount computed in batchSend as _value multiplied by array length.
Local pair address computed by pairFor inside ensure.
Source address parameter of transferFrom and ensure.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom and transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer, transferFrom, approve, ensure and condition.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Sale count parameter of init.
Target address parameter of delegate receiving the delegatecall.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
Minimum sale token amount parameter of init.

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal owner before the privileged delegatecall function executes.
init is reachable only when msg.sender equals owner, guarding sale limit configuration.
batchSend requires msg.sender to be the owner before distributing balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender to be the owner before updating the whitelist.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when checking and decrementing allowance.
msg.sender is stored as owner and credited the total supply during construction.
The delegate function passes its payload into the low-level delegatecall.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the calldata executed by the delegatecall.
transferFrom invokes ensure to validate the transfer participants.
ensure delegates authorization decisions to condition when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure computes the pair address through pairFor to build the whitelist.
ensure stores the computed pair address in the local _UNI used for whitelist comparison.
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure reads owner as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure reads canSale to grant unconditional sale permission.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for source and destination.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance for the spender.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum for the source address.
transferFrom mutates allowance and balance mappings with unchecked subtraction and addition.
batchSend multiplies value by array length and adds balances without overflow checks.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
batchSend derives the local total from parameter _value and _tos length.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom using msg.sender as source.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of allowed sales.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
init writes the computed minimum sale into _minSale.
init writes the computed maximum sale into _maxSale.
init writes the supplied sale count into _saleNum.
setTradeAddress writes the trade whitelist address.
The constructor stores the deploying account as owner.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied supply value.
The constructor credits the deployer balance with the total supply.
The constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and spender.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
Parameter _from is the debited address in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the credited address in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the amount debited, credited and checked.
Parameter _tos provides the recipient list iterated by batchSend.
Parameter _value is the per-recipient amount used in batchSend.
Parameter saleNum is assigned to the _saleNum state variable.
Parameter token derives the minimum sale threshold in init.

normalization_plan.reason: Local total is computed solely for the unchecked multiplication in batchSend and is absorbed into that unsafe operation.
Local _UNI only holds the pairFor result used for the whitelist check inside ensure.
Parameter _from is the debited account of transferFrom and has no meaning outside it.
Parameter _to is the credited account of transferFrom and has no meaning outside it.
Parameter _value is the amount validated and moved by transferFrom.
Parameter _tos is the iteration source for the batchSend distribution loop.
Parameter saleNum is consumed only by init when writing _saleNum.
Parameter a is consumed only as the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b is consumed only as the delegatecall calldata.
Parameter token is consumed only by init to derive _minSale.
